summary.name: Deco IDE
summary.one_liner: Deco IDE is a React Native development environment that lets you edit style values with visual controls and search for and insert open-source React Native components.
use_cases: Tweaking style values like font size and color while the app runs
Finding open-source React Native components to reuse
Inserting and customizing UI components with one click
Building React Native apps for iOS
summary.what_it_does: The page describes editing values in code and adjusting them with context-appropriate controls such as sliders or color pickers, with changes showing up in the running app. It offers a search for existing open-source React Native components, with thumbnail previews, that can be inserted with one click and then customized. Example components named include Date Picker (iOS), Picker, and Progress View (iOS). The page also promotes a developer meetup community across several cities.
notable: Live style editing with sliders and color pickers that update the running app
Searchable library of open-source React Native components with thumbnail previews
caveats: Platforms the IDE runs on are not stated on the page
Listing marks it as open source and freeware, but the page text itself does not state licensing or pricing
